notes.title: Meditation VR 0.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Meditation VR 0.2 Release Notes:[/h1]

The first big update to Meditation VR is now live! We hope these changes make the beach feel even more relaxing to you. 

[h2][b]What's New[/b][/h2]

⦁	Extended timelapse. Now you can watch the sun set!
⦁	A completely redesigned menu with some new tweaks such as the ability to turn off the guided meditation or the beach chair from the menu.
⦁	Spotify integration, instead of the default track you can now listen to 4 playlists created by us. Requires Spotify to be running in the background.
⦁	A completely re-recorded voice-over with a professional voice actress.

[h2][b]Tweaks & Bugfixes[/b][/h2]

⦁	Audio & video settings will now be saved properly.
⦁	The ocean material has been changed to be reflective and feel more like water.
⦁	The animal paths have been redone to be more noticeable and look better.
⦁	Default position has been moved back so you can more easily relax and still see the details on the island
⦁	Foliage and assets have been tweaked to better match the new default player position
⦁	We've removed a few quality settings that were causing performance issues with some users
⦁	Tweaked the sky to show more detail around the sun
